system.description: You can call in a small favor from someone who owes you. Once per day, make a DC 25 Persuasion check. If the check is successful, an informant gives you information, granting you a +10 competence bonus to one Gather Information or Knowledge check made within the next 24 hours.

prerequisite.text: Notorious (Infamy Talent Tree) talent, and Trained in Persuasion
